title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Sour Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Sour Edition Pre Filled Pods for the Elf Bar Dual 10K are built for fans of tangy, sharp flavour. One pod features Sour Blackcurrant - a bold, dark fruit with a juicy tartness. The second pod delivers Sour Pineapple Lemonade, bringing tropical brightness and fizzy citrus for a truly puckering finish. Each pod is Pre Filled with 2ml of e-liquid and includes a built-in 5ml refill chamber that feeds automatically from within the Dual 10K device. If your taste leans towards zesty and vibrant, Sour Edition hits all the right notes. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
